products.title: Our Products
products.subtitle: Five specialized tools, unified by a philosophy: local-first, privacy-respecting, works offline.

descriptions.media: Offline-first music and video player for Android. Scan local media, build playlists and enjoy persistent playback without the cloud.
descriptions.sms: AI-powered SMS assistant with a local Ollama brain and an acoustic voice bridge powered by Whisper and Piper.
descriptions.phonelink: Wireless Android remote management from a Linux desktop. Mirror the screen, transfer files and control devices on your LAN.
descriptions.neural: Modular AI execution platform with the MrX coding agent, task engines, device automation and integrated subsystems.
descriptions.shulebomba: Offline-first class management for teachers. Track multiple classes, attendance, test scores and printable reports in one app.

why.title: Different by design
why.subtitle: We don't just add AI as a feature. We build software where on-device intelligence is the foundation.

meta.title: Privacy Policy
meta.description: GBrain Technologies Privacy Policy — how we collect, use, and protect your data. Local-first, privacy-respecting software.

intro.title: Introduction
intro.content: GBrain Technologies Company Limited ("GBrain", "we", "us", "our") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your information when you use our website, products, and services.

data.title: Data We Collect
data.content: We collect minimal data necessary to provide our services:
items: Account information (if you create one): name, email
Contact form submissions: name, email, message content
Newsletter subscriptions: email address
Website analytics: anonymous usage data (via Plausible/Fathom, no cookies)
Error logs: technical data for debugging (via Sentry, no PII)
Product usage: only if you opt-in; all product data stays on your device

usage.title: How We Use Your Data
usage.content: We use your data only for:
items: Responding to your inquiries and support requests
Sending newsletter updates (only with consent)
Improving our website and products
Security and fraud prevention
Legal compliance

sharing.title: Data Sharing
sharing.content: We do not sell your data. We may share data only in these cases:
items: With your explicit consent
With service providers (Resend for email, Vercel for hosting, Sentry for errors) under strict DPAs
When required by law or to protect our rights
In aggregate, anonymized form for analytics

cookies.title: Cookies & Tracking
items: Essential: session management, CSRF protection
Preferences: theme (light/dark), locale
Analytics: Plausible/Fathom (privacy-friendly, no personal data)
No advertising cookies, no third-party tracking cookies

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.content: Under GDPR, Tanzania PDPA, and other laws, you have the right to:
items: Access your personal data
Rectify inaccurate data
Erase your data ("right to be forgotten")
Restrict or object to processing
Data portability
Withdraw consent at any time

security.title: Data Security
security.content: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures: TLS encryption, secure headers, access controls, regular security reviews. However, no internet transmission is 100% secure.

changes.title: Policy Changes
changes.content: We may update this policy. Material changes will be notified via email or website banner. Continued use constitutes acceptance.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.content: Questions about this policy? Contact our Data Protection Officer at privacy@gbrain.tech or write to GBrain Technologies Company Limited, Dar es Salaam, Tanzania.

meta.title: Cookie Policy
meta.description: GBrain Technologies Cookie Policy — what cookies we use, why, and how to manage them.

what.title: What Are Cookies?
what.content: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. They help the site function properly and provide analytics.

types.title: Types of Cookies We Use
items: Essential: Required for site functionality (session, CSRF, preferences)
Analytics: Plausible/Fathom (anonymous, privacy-first, no personal data)
Preferences: Theme (light/dark), language locale
No marketing, advertising, or third-party tracking cookies

purpose.title: Purpose of Cookies
items: Remember your theme and language preferences
Maintain secure sessions
Understand anonymous usage patterns to improve the site
Prevent cross-site request forgery

thirdParty.title: Third-Party Cookies
thirdParty.content: We do not set third-party cookies directly. Our analytics providers (Plausible/Fathom) may set first-party cookies on our domain for anonymous measurement.
items: Plausible: anonymous page view tracking
Fathom: privacy-first analytics
Vercel: deployment analytics (if enabled)
No Google Analytics, Facebook Pixel, or ad tracking

consent.title: Consent
consent.content: Essential cookies are set automatically. Analytics cookies require your consent via our cookie banner. You can withdraw consent anytime.
items: Cookie banner appears on first visit
Granular control: accept all, reject analytics, or customize
Preferences saved for 1 year
Easy withdrawal via cookie settings link in footer

manage.title: Managing Cookies
items: Browser settings: block, delete, or alert for cookies
Our cookie settings link (footer): change preferences anytime
Private/incognito mode: cookies deleted on close
Note: blocking essential cookies may break site functionality

changes.title: Policy Changes
changes.content: We may update this policy. Changes will be posted with a revised date. Continued use constitutes acceptance.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.content: Questions about cookies? Contact us at privacy@gbrain.tech.

security.title: Security
security.description: How GBrain approaches security across website, products and local AI execution.
security.body: GBrain products are designed to keep data on your device. Our website uses HTTPS, security headers and minimal data collection. Local AI runs without mandatory cloud services, and any remote access should be placed behind a VPN on a trusted network.
items: Local-first execution for AI features
Trusted-LAN defaults for device control
Approval gates for consequential agent actions
Minimal website data collection and no advertising trackers
